phase: The assigned at-home hours turned from a denial into a fact to weigh. Each citizen is told their own weekday figure - 12.1 hours on average across the sixty - and the plans keep them home 17.7. This is the first candidate aimed at the home bias with a target taken from the citizen own input.
primary: Absolute gap between planned hours at home and the hours that citizen own profile assigns. Measured at +5.6 hours on average with 427 of 480 cells more than two hours over. Two-sided: a citizen assigned 18.3 hours should stay home more.
limitations: Closing the gap is internal consistency, not evidence that any published effect was reproduced.
The control is the v18 v25 arm - same cohort, same seed, same source - so only the treatment arm is run.
If the gap closes by padding the day with outings that buy nothing, that is not progress; purchases and event counts are reported alongside.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Single arm against the v18 v25 arm (experiments/v19/prompt_v19.md). v35 differs from v25 by one sentence; enforced by test_home_hours_candidate.py.
